title: Kirby Problem 4.102
exact_target: Ask whether every rational cuspidal symplectic curve is equisingularly isotopic to a complex curve, classify types admitting exceptions, and record the universal pair-isotopy question together with its known complex Zariski-pair counterexamples.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2978 (KP-4.102). CC BY 4.0.
